title: The Golden Bull (1222) - Az Aranybulla (1222)
grammar: aki és amely: személyek és dolgok

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can explain what the Aranybulla (Golden Bull) of 1222 was and who issued it.
I can describe why the Hungarian nobility pressed II. András to issue the Golden Bull.
I can name at least two rights the Golden Bull guaranteed and briefly compare it to England's Magna Carta.
I can distinguish 'aki' (for people) from 'amely' (for things) in a relative clause.
I can build a sentence combining a person clause (aki) and a thing clause (amely) about the same event.
